items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: I was very much influenced by Lucky Roberts, the great black pianist

ctx.x: Yes. But to get back to Hawkins now, I could easily say that I was influenced by Hawkins, but not as strongly as I was by the black singers, the dancers and all the -- especially pianists, I was very much influenced by Lucky Roberts, the great black pianist, James P. Johnson, Fats Waller, Earl Hines. I was very much influenced by many of the great black clarinet players.
You didn't hear Lucky Roberts in Chicago, did you -- it was in New York...
